name: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG
summary: Bayerische Motoren Werke Aktiengesellschaft, or BMW AG, is a global enterprise that develops, manufactures, and distributes a wide range of automobiles, motorcycles, and associated spare parts and accessories under its BMW, MINI, and Rolls-Royce brands. Founded in 1916, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Munich, Germany.
